products.description:
Final Fantasy TCG: Journey of Discovery Booster Box 

﻿Product Details
Journey of Discovery” features many appealing cards, including brand-new illustrations and characters making their card debut. Additionally, all “Limit Break” cards included in this booster pack—a key element for multifaceted strategies—will be multi-element, providing a wide range of options for LB decks. “Journey of Discovery” will significantly expand the possibilities for both deck construction and strategic play.
This set will also come with 28 newly illustrated cards centered around characters from FINAL FANTASY VIII. Also included as an extremely rare Special card is Terra [27-014H], showcasing a brand-new illustration Fumio Minagawa, and featuring his signature foil-stamped on a card for the first time. This set is designed to appeal not only to players but also to collectors, and is sure to resonate with many existing players and FINAL FANTASY fans.
In addition, Legacy cards—powerful cards from the past selected for inclusion as premium full art cards—continue to be featured in this booster pack. The following three cards are included in this set: Regis [12-122L], Neo Exdeath [21-074L], and Ace [22-116L]. Special cards and Legacy cards are not only for collection purposes as they can both be used in official tournaments, just like normal cards.

The new FFTCG booster pack, “Dreamlike Oceans,” is scheduled for release on March 27, 2026. This commemorative pack celebrates the 15th anniversary of the first booster pack in the Chapter series, “Chapter I,” which was released in Japan before the Opus series.

The ever-popular Special card is Yuna [28-111H], illustrated by Tetsuya Nomura, and features the artist’s foil-stamped signature, just like previous cards, which adds extra appeal for collectors. The “Limit Break” cards included in this set, like those in the previous “Journey of Discovery,” are multi-attribute cards that offer diverse options not only for “LB decks” but also for the entire deck.
